mentions.name: Fluxmail
mentions.description: Fluxmail is an AI-native email app that includes an AI agent, automatic prioritization and categorization of email, automatic follow-up reminders, and AI-assisted drafting. It is also integrating a kanban view for emails.
mentions.problem: Managing a high volume of email.
mentions.audience: AI-native email app for people who get a lot of email.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Fluxmail, an AI-native email app for people who get a lot of email. It has an AI agent, automatic prioritization and categorization, automatic follow-up reminders, drafting with AI, and a bunch of other stuff.
